name: When should my business consider getting a GEO website audit?

mainEntity.name: When should my business consider getting a GEO website audit?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your business should consider a GEO website audit if you are experiencing a decline in local search rankings, struggling to attract local customers, or expanding into new geographic markets. It's also beneficial after a website redesign, a Google algorithm update, or if your competitors seem to be gaining local search visibility. Proactive audits, typically annually or semi-annually, can help maintain and improve your local online presence, ensuring you stay ahead in your target areas. If your business heavily relies on local clientele, regular audits are a strategic necessity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider a GEO website audit if local search rankings decline, you're not attracting local customers, expanding markets, or after a website redesign or algorithm update. Proactive audits maintain local online presence.
